text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin isn't feeling very motivated, so I take her to a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We pray and draw our fortunes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I was wondering where you were taking me, but a shrine? Really?
choice_data_list: I thought it would make you feel better.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… If wishes really came true so easily, there would be literally no more suffering in the—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hang on… Taishin?! Is that you? Heeeey!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, you two came to pray too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: We're about to leave. We already prayed and got our fortunes and everything.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Don't go yet! Do it again so we can make a wish together! Please? Pleeease?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Praying twice is better than once, and doing it three times is even better! The more you pray, the more likely your wish'll come true!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Winning Ticket's insistence, we get back in line to pray.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, gods—and the Buddha too! Grant my wiiiish!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This is a Shinto shrine, Ticket. The Buddha isn't here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Why the heck am I even doing this?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, what fortunes did everyone get? I got "good fortune"!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I got "modest fortune." Not bad. What about you, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …I got "great fortune."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's not like it's super rare or anything.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Not everyone has great luck, after all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If you combine it with my good luck and Hayahide's modest luck, your wish will definitely come true!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll feel totally better in no time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, I suppose we should tell you. We actually came here to pray for your good health.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We want to race you when you're in top fighting shape after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Did you two really…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, who asked you to do that?! You boneheads!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, it seems like their wishes come true with Narita Taishin making a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …I got "great misfortune."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! They say you always get a "great fortune" after drawing that one!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However… it appears that they've run out of fortunes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Does that mean Taishin's stuck with the worst possible luck?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't really care, actually…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But you should care! Oh, poor Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geez… Shut up already! And stop crying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she's able to calm Winning Ticket afterward, Narita Taishin's condition unfortunately doesn't improve.
